name: collapse-tools
description: Claude Fold: Collapses each tool call to one clickable line in a color you pick, showing the model's own description of the call where it has one.

doneColor.title: Completed call color
doneColor.description: Color of the tool name when a call completed successfully (running calls are yellow, errors red). Theme key or color, for example white, gray, cyan, #7d9a83. Default white.

summaries.title: Row summaries
summaries.description: Show the description the model wrote for a call (Bash, Agent, Monitor) instead of the raw argument on collapsed rows. Default on.
